x-aisa-source.conversion_notes: Types, explicit required/default values and nested fields come from official tables. Conditional plan limits and time syntax remain in source descriptions; unspecified defaults and response-field types are not inferred.

requestBody.description:
Top-level parameters:
highlights object form:
contentMaxChars body-text limit:
This is a top-level integer, not a field inside highlights. Only send it when you need to limit returned body text. With needContent: true and body-content access enabled, it limits the total characters across all strings in each result's sentence array, independently per result. Omit it or send null for the full available body text.
The limit counts Unicode code points in UTF-8 body text, preserves sentence order, and may cut the last retained sentence short. It does not include JSON formatting or separators added by your application. It does not limit snippet or highlights, and it does not change page-based billing. Use highlights.maxCharacters (100–8000) to control query-focused fragments separately.
filters sub-object:
timeRange.date syntax:
d[n] / w[n] / m[n] / y[n]: last n days / weeks / months / years, e.g. d7, m3
YYYY-MM-DDtoYYYY-MM-DD: a range, e.g. 2022-04-01to2022-07-30; a single day uses the same to form
geo.countries.include allowed values: argentina, australia, brazil, canada, colombia, france, germany, india, indonesia, japan, mexico, nigeria, philippines, south korea, spain, united kingdom, united states.
languages.include allowed values: english, japanese, korean, german, french, spanish, portuguese, russian.
vertical allowed values: code, finance. Lowercase and strictly enumerated; omit the field for universal search.

query.description: Search term. Supports long natural-language descriptions

count.description: Maximum number of results returned. Default: server default (value unspecified).

chunksPerDoc.description: Summary chunks per document. Free / PAYG support up to 1; Enterprise up to 3. Deprecated — still available, but migrate to highlights

query.description: Keyword that guides the extraction; falls back to the top-level query when omitted

maxCharacters.description: Length of each extracted fragment, in characters, between 100 and 8000; the model picks the most suitable length when omitted

highlights.description: Request relevant fragments from the body text. true extracts against the original query at the length the model judges best; the object form takes query and maxCharacters, see below

needContent.description: Whether to return body text. When true, body text lands in each result's sentence field (sentence array)

contentMaxChars.description: Optional body-text length limit per result, from 1 to 1,000,000 Unicode code points. Used with needContent: true; omit or send null to return the full available body text without truncation. Default: Full available body text (value unspecified).

include.description: Only pull results from these sites; an empty array means no restriction
Only return results from these countries
Only return results in these languages

vertical.description: Vertical search. Supported values: "code", "finance"; omit for universal search

200.description: Official response table. Fields on each results.result[] item: url, title, snippet, page_age (plaintext UTC+0 time), site_name, site_icon, sentence (string[], present only when needContent: true and body text is available), highlights (string[], present only when highlights is set on the request and body text is available). Every result field is optional. Some results in the same response may have no sentence or highlights. Treat a missing field as "body text unavailable," not as an error.

error_code.description: Error code, consistent with the HTTP status code; 200 on success

search_id.description: Unique request identifier; give it to support when reporting an issue

query.description: The query that was actually executed
